description: Synthetic enterprise AI deployment policies. Fictional — not any real company's policy set.

policies.title: Audit logging must be enabled
policies.remediation: Enable audit logging for every model invocation and route logs to the central audit store.

policies.title: Model version must be pinned
policies.remediation: Pin an explicit model version in configuration so behavior cannot change underneath the application.

policies.title: Enterprise identity is required
policies.remediation: Integrate with enterprise identity (IAM, SSO, or OIDC); no shared or static credentials.

policies.title: Egress controls must be documented
policies.remediation: Document every network destination the application can reach and the control that enforces it.

policies.title: No unauthorized external egress
policies.remediation: Remove external egress, or route it through an approved governed-egress gateway with a registered exception.

policies.title: Human approval required for restricted or confidential data
policies.remediation: Require human approval before outputs that touch restricted or confidential data are acted on.

policies.title: Encryption in transit is required
policies.remediation: Enforce TLS 1.2+ for all traffic between the application, the model gateway, and data stores.

policies.title: Restricted data requires at least 365 days of audit retention
policies.remediation: Retain audit logs for at least 365 days for applications that process restricted data.

policies.title: Model access must go through the enterprise model gateway
policies.remediation: Route all model calls through the enterprise model gateway instead of calling providers directly.
